evidence.observation: Plan §7 still asserts as a current fact: "The whole-repository ruff red (H27) and the stale lines of `project.md`, its lint-gate sentence among them `(p1)` (D11): owner policy, outside a phase." But plan §11 amendment 4 (c1) amends H27 with "at the close, `main` at `f7fad6a1`, the whole-repository command exits 0", and close-results.md line 32 records "`uv run ruff check` | `All checks passed!`, exit 0 (red when the plan was written, plan H27)". Unlike the §1 H27 row, whose r4 wording is deliberately kept beside the §11 amendment, §7's bullet is unqualified plan text, so r5 contradicts itself on whether the whole-repository ruff is red. Unlike §11's rows, no part of §7 marks this bullet as kept r4 wording.

concerns.recommendation: Repair the §7 bullet at the next plan touch (or annotate it with the (c1) amendment) so it no longer asserts the whole-repository ruff is red, since amendment 4 and close-results record it green at f7fad6a1.
